ns2:section.sectionText: Seminar in Library Management: Social Crisis Management and the Emerging Role of the Information Professional. Crisis situations arise in all types of libraries and impact staff and users. Information professionals must be prepared to meet the social, psychological, medical and legal situations caused by drug overdoses, sexual assault, homelessness, neglect and mental illness. Students will explore the issues and possible resolutions to social crisis management. Previous syllabus: https://ischoolapps.sjsu.edu/gss/ajax/showSheet.php?id=8584 Course Code: SJ-INFO282-CMER2209-SJSU-14, Dates: 8/26/2020 - 9/23/2020
